item.subject: science
item.stem:
Ravi notices mosquito larvae wriggling in a tub of stagnant water kept behind his house in Chennai. His grandmother pours a thin layer of kerosene over the surface of the water.

Mosquito larvae live in water but must come to the surface to take in air.

What will happen to the larvae, and why?

options.A: The larvae will die, because the kerosene layer stops them from reaching air at the surface.
options.B: The larvae will survive, because they can breathe air through the thin kerosene layer.
options.C: The larvae will survive, because living in water gives them everything they need.
options.D: The larvae will die, because kerosene is a poison that dissolves into the water.
